correctness.rationale: Basis of six differentials follows from unique infinity pole orders (-4,-5,-5). Cartier coefficients follow F^((11*l-j)/4), giving 3-by-1 V,1-by-3 W and 2-by-2 B with W=(1,0,2a), determinant D. Crucially use Frobenius-twisted compositions E^(11)E, not ordinary generic square: V-W subsystem stable rank 2 iff L=v0+2a^11*v2 !=0, B subsystem rank 2 iff D!=0 and otherwise 1 iff K=m10^11*m01+3 !=0. Discriminant exclusion prevents V=0 in smooth domain. Independently recomputed F11 Cartier ranks over all 121 prime-field pairs (10 singular,86 rank4/a2,15 rank2/a2,10 rank3/a3). Independently recomputed exact lex Gröbner elimination for (L,D) and (D,K): univariate degrees 75 and 70, both squarefree, both coprime to resultant of (D,Delta), intersection ideal (L,D,K)=(1). The algebraic elimination certifies counts over the full algebraic closure; the 121-field census alone could not.
